messages:
Anna (CS): Quick intro for Kairos onboarding. Need to lock stakeholders, measurable success criteria, and a tight 3-week kickoff plan. Who can own what?

Miguel (CS): I can be primary CS lead. Free Thu morning for a 20m sync.

Sam (PM): I'll drive milestones and OKRs. Add business criteria: 3 internal champion signoffs + one exec demo acceptance.

Jess (Eng): Engineering will take integration & perf. Heads up: customer requires KMS + IP allowlist and data-residency notes.

Devon (SE): Ops/runbook + enablement demo owner. Need a representative test corpus and access matrix from Kairos.

Anna (CS): Proposed compact success criteria:
• Performance: p95 < 350ms on gen calls
• Reliability: >= 99% availability on trial traffic
• Functionality: streaming + function-calls + embeddings validated
• Business: exec demo accepted by day 21, 1st 1k validated requests within 30 days

Timeline (compact):
Day 0 (this week) 1 1 account provisioning, IP/KMS exchange, sample data
Day 3 1 integration + smoke tests
Day 8 1 UAT start + perf tuning
Day 15 1 internal QA + dry-run demo
Day 21 1 exec demo + go/no-go decision

Miguel (CS): Renewal/contract risk: CFO review in 45 days, likely to re-evaluate spend. If no clear progress by day 21 we may lose runway. Recommend exec weekly brief at day 10 & 20.

Sam (PM): Agreed. I'll ask Sales to request a soft hold on auto-renew clauses until post-demo. Also will prepare a 30/60/90 milestone doc and feedback capture form.

Jess (Eng): Infra Q: customer asked for Dedicated trial pool. Need VM sizing and GPU tier. Can we start with 1x A10G equivalent?

Anna (CS): They requested Dedicated but are flexible on sizing. Miguel please confirm with their infra contact.

Devon (SE): Enablement plan: 45-minute walkthrough during UAT + a 2-page ops runbook (incident + rollback). I'll draft runbook and demo script.

Jess (Eng): Perf test harness I'll run:
```
# perf smoke
./tools/loadtest --url https://kairos-trial.redwood --concurrency 10 --requests 500 --streaming
```
I'll post results to the tracker.

OnboardBot: Calendar invite posted for initial sync: 2026-05-08 16:00 UTC. Reminder set 24h prior.

Sam (PM): I'll share the 30/60/90 doc + onboard-feedback form link here after the sync.

Anna (CS): Action list quick: Miguel 1 confirm IP/KMS + infra contact by Fri; Jess 1 provisional infra and perf script by Mon; Devon 1 runbook draft + demo script by Tue; Sam 1 milestones + feedback form by Wed. I'll prep Confluence recap post-meeting.

Miguel (CS): On it. Will ping Kairos for KMS policy and their sample corpus.

Jess (Eng): Added tickets: #ONB-512 infra-provision, #ONB-513 perf, #ONB-514 UAT-checklist. ETA Mon EOD for initial infra PR.

Devon (SE): Runbook draft ETA Tue EOD. Will include rollback steps and monitoring checks.

Sam (PM): Posting milestone doc here when ready.

Anna (CS): Thanks team 1 closing thread; will reconvene after the sync. :rocket:
